**Note: We do not currently accept external pull requests.**

Meridian is developed internally and mirrored to GitHub, so external pull
requests cannot be merged directly and will be closed automatically.

Instead of opening a pull request, please:

*   Open an [issue](https://github.com/google/meridian/issues) to report a bug
    or propose a change.
*   Start a thread in
    [Discussions](https://github.com/google/meridian/discussions) for feature
    requests or usage questions.

See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/google/meridian/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
for more details.
